_doc: Held-out AML seeds as salted hashes. Append-only: a hash may be appended to a role's list, a seed to spent (a held-out seed only after its look is recorded in aml_registered_looks.json), and absence_check may move from report to enforce. Nothing else changes; config/datagen_seed.py heldout_history_problems is the rule. The salt is public.
